source_name: RBI — Sectoral Deployment of Bank Credit
concept: Outstanding scheduled commercial bank credit for Vehicle Loans (a sub-segment of Personal Loans) — a leading indicator of retail auto demand financing. Compared against total non-food bank credit so the spread shows whether auto credit is running hotter or cooler than the broader lending cycle.
coverage_note: Each row is the outstanding amount as of the last reporting Friday of that calendar month, taken directly from RBI's Sectoral Deployment of Bank Credit release (Statement 1: Deployment of Gross Bank Credit by Major Sectors). YoY% values are RBI's printed year-on-year growth.
